title: The brave fight is inward
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Let this stay near the next choice: remember this: measure courage by how deeply ego is subdued.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person.
source.lifeApplication: When conflict sharpens, fight the ego within before you fight anyone else.
